faq.q: What is the Vintage Vice City pack in GTA 6?
faq.a: It is Rockstar's pre-order bonus for Grand Theft Auto VI, included at no extra cost with any pre-order, Standard or Ultimate, placed before 20 November 2026. It is a bonus content pack, not a standalone edition.

faq.q: What is included in the Vintage Vice City pack?
faq.a: It contains a 1955 Vapid Stanier sedan with its own garage space, access to the Ocean Beach area, period-styled outfits and hairstyles for both Jason and Lucia, and a themed weapon pattern.

faq.q: Do I need to buy the Ultimate Edition to get the Vintage Vice City pack?
faq.a: No. The pack is free with any pre-order placed before 20 November 2026, on either the Standard Edition or the Ultimate Edition.

faq.q: Can the Vintage Vice City pack be bought after the pre-order window closes?
faq.a: Rockstar has not said. The record confirms the pack is free with pre-orders placed before 20 November 2026, but does not state whether it can be purchased or unlocked any other way afterward.

faq.q: Is the Ocean Beach area only accessible through the Vintage Vice City pack?
faq.a: The record only says the pack grants access to Ocean Beach. It does not say whether that area is reachable another way for players who do not pre-order.

notKnown: Whether the Vintage Vice City pack becomes available after the 20 November 2026 pre-order deadline.
Whether Ocean Beach can be reached without the pack.

howWeKnow: The pre-order bonus terms for Grand Theft Auto VI, including the Vintage Vice City pack, were published in an official Rockstar Newswire post on 24 June 2026. As a first-party Rockstar announcement, it is the direct source for the pack's contents and eligibility window.
